tickets.title: Follow up on account security item
tickets.text: Review the reported account security concern, confirm the client’s preferred secure communication method, verify whether access credentials, multi-factor authentication, trusted contacts, or recent account activity require attention, and document the resolution steps. Do not request or record passwords or authentication codes. Elena Mossbutton could not open the shared vault invitation because the authentication prompt failed, so review vault access, trusted contacts, and secure delivery preferences.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to review vault access, trusted contacts, and secure delivery preferences by 2024-04-08, without collecting passwords or codes.

tickets.title: Concentrated Holding Snapshot
tickets.text: Prepare a current snapshot of Julian Mossbutton's Pocket Lantern Systems stock exposure, which represents about 18% of the household's investable assets, covering unrealized gain, vesting schedule, and liquidity implications for the estate review.
tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare a current snapshot of the Pocket Lantern Systems stock exposure, unrealized gain, vesting schedule, and liquidity implications by 2024-04-19.

tickets.title: Prepare retirement income plan
tickets.text: Develop a retirement income plan using the client's stated retirement timing, spending goals, guaranteed income sources, portfolio resources, tax considerations, and liquidity needs. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare a clear recommendation summary for review. Julian Mossbutton plans to retire from full-time work at the end of 2027, Elena expects to work until 2029 with a projected $21,000 annual pension from Cloudberry Kite School, Julian's Social Security estimate is about $3,250 per month at full retirement age, and the household holds $185,000 in cash reserves at Teacup Comet Bank.

subTasks.title: Gather retirement income inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending estimates, anticipated retirement date or phase-in plan, Social Security or pension information, expected withdrawals, cash reserves, and known large upcoming expenses.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and income scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare base, conservative, and flexible withdrawal scenarios. Note sequence-of-return risk, inflation assumptions, tax-sensitive account sequencing, and any years with unusual income or deductions.

subTasks.title: Identify tax-aware implementation steps
subTasks.text: Review opportunities for Roth conversions, capital gain harvesting, charitable giving strategies, estimated tax payments, and coordination with the client's CPA where appropriate.

subTasks.title: Prepare client review summary
subTasks.text: Summarize recommended income sources, withdrawal order, cash reserve target, key risks, open questions, and follow-up actions for the client meeting.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to prepare that roadmap by 2024-04-26.
